subject: From Drive, Chip and Putt to the LPGA Winner’s Circle

A full circle journey from junior golf to professional triumph.

From Drive, Chip and Putt to the LPGA Winner’s Circle
Evidence: junior golf, LPGA, success

Yana Wilson and Gina Kim achieved their first LPGA Tour victories by winning the 2026 Dow Championship. Both players previously showcased their talent at Augusta National through the Drive, Chip and Putt competition.

The article details how Yana Wilson and Gina Kim, both former Drive, Chip and Putt national champions, have now reached the pinnacle of professional golf by winning an LPGA Tour event, highlighting the foundational role of junior golf.
